info.title: OpenApps API
info.summary: What is listed, ranked, featured and launched in the AI app stores (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Grok Bot), and the MCP servers they link to.
info.description: Read-only and public. Every answer is { data, meta }; meta.basis says what each value is (observed, store_reported, derived, proxy). Links in rows point at https://theopenapps.com. x-openapps-cache: an answer stands until new data lands (data), an MCP server's tools change (data_or_tools) or the UTC day ends (day). Agents: https://theopenapps.com/v1/agent-context, MCP at https://theopenapps.com/mcp.

get.summary: A store's changes: ranks, featuring, launches, listings, releases, MCP tools and status, delistings, metrics.
get.description: Up to 30 days. listing_change: dated field values; release_change: builds or reviewed commits; mcp_status_change: servers down, needing sign-in or back; delisted: needs complete current catalogs in every reachable region; metric_change: clears per-metric floors, never rank proxies.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: App store.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: ChatGPT country code (us, de…), global, or directory (Cursor). Default: main catalog.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Start of the window: ISO-8601, or relative to the latest data (-24h, -7d).

parameters.name: apps
parameters.description: 1 to 10 listing refs or OpenApps URLs.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Event types to keep. Default: all but release_change.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's meta.next_cursor.

200.description: { data, meta }: meta says when the data is from (as_of), how fresh it is, and the basis of each field.

ETag.description: Changes when the answer does; send it back in If-None-Match.

Cache-Control.description: Fresh until new data for the store is due.

OpenApps-Contract.description: Hash of the API contract that answered.

get.summary: What moved in a store's latest data: rank movers in its lead charts, featured-list entries and exits, metric changes.
get.description: Use for a store's headlines: who climbed, fell or entered its charts, joined or left a featured list, or changed installs or scores. By default every ranking chart, each product once where it moved most; chart: one chart, every mover. For a span of time, use changes_list.

parameters.description: Movement against the previous day (1d) or a week earlier (7d).

parameters.name: max_position
parameters.description: Only rows at or above this position now (1-based).

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: App kinds, bare (connector) or store-qualified (claude:connector, chatgpt:apps_sdk); a value qualified by another store is ignored.

200.description: { data, meta }: meta says when the data is from (as_of), how fresh it is, and the basis of each field.

icon.description: Its best-ranked listing's icon

rank.description: Among the apps with the tag
The listing's OpenApps Rank in its store

score.description: Mean daily points over the window: 1/position on each counted chart, weighted

rank.description: By score among the store's apps, 1 first

tier.description: 3: top 10 on a counted chart today, 2: top 50, 1: charted within the window

peak.description: Best position on a counted chart in the window

momentum.description: Score minus the previous window's; null until that window has enough days

chart_ranks.description: Its OpenApps Rank among the apps scored on each chart, not its position in the chart (listings_ranks_current has those)

validation.description: Newest check against each published count: Spearman rho, share on the same side of the median

304.description: Not modified since the ETag in If-None-Match.

400.description: An input is invalid; error.param names it and error.allowed lists valid values.

403.description: error.code plan_required: the caller's plan does not open the input, and error.need names the plan that does (free: an account; plus: Pro). Missing catalog:read scope: error is a string, with an OAuth challenge.

WWW-Authenticate.description: OAuth challenge, for a missing scope.

error.description: An Error's error, or a string for a missing scope

404.description: Nothing matches, e.g. an unknown app or chart; error.nearest lists the closest known values.

429.description: Too many requests from this address in the last minute.

500.description: OpenApps failed; the message carries a reference to quote.

DeveloperKey.description: Create a developer key in your OpenApps account. Public reads also work without credentials.

OAuth.description: Request resource=https://theopenapps.com/v1 and use PKCE S256.
